Sign in to Figdoc

A Google account is required to prepare and download documents.

After signing in in your browser, copy your connection code and paste it here.

Closing the plugin signs you out. Your design content stays in Figma.
  1. Select frames or layers.
  2. Prepare your document.
  3. Download Word or PDF, or import JSON into Figdoc to edit.
